description: A React component implementing an auto-expanding textarea with dynamic height adjustment based on content, styled with utility classes.

classes.name: AutoExpandingTextarea
classes.description: A React forwardRef functional component providing an auto-expanding textarea input.

methods.description: Handles input events to trigger height adjustment and propagate the event.

methods.description: Handles change events to trigger height adjustment and propagate the event.
